liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Rosa Lee McFall (Charlie Monroe cover)**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 11 archived performances [8]
- **Black Mountain Rag (The Doc Watson Family cover) Billy Strings Solo**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **Pancho & Lefty (Townes Van Zandt cover) Billy Strings Solo**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2019-11-01.Gefel_aeta4MinX** (recommended): source not stated; 24 songs; 133 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [1]
- **billystrings2019-11-01.akg568**: source not stated; 24 songs; 133 min [2]. Said about its sound: The whole acoustic band was captured on a single microphone [2]
- **billystrings2019-11-01.akg483**: source not stated; 24 songs; 133 min [3]. Said about its sound: The whole acoustic band was captured on a single microphone [3]
- **billystrings2019-11-01**: source not stated; 24 songs; 133 min [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2019-11-01.Gefel_aeta4MinX**: taped by hypnocracy; transferred by hypnocracy; source: Gefell M210 (PAS @ SNB)> AETA 4MinX 44.1kh 24bit [1]
- **billystrings2019-11-01.akg568**: taped by DavidPuddy; transferred by DavidPuddy; source: AKG 568 > Sound Devices MixPre 6 [2]. Also: Recorded with an AKG 568 microphone into a Sound Devices MixPre 6, placed left of the board, about ten feet away; Transfer chain runs from the SD card through Audacity and Reaper, ending in xAct [2]
- **billystrings2019-11-01.akg483**: taped by DavidPuddy; transferred by DavidPuddy; source: AKG 480/ck63 > Sound Devices MixPre 6 [3]. Also: Recorded with an AKG 480 body and ck63 capsule into a Sound Devices MixPre 6, placed left of the board, about ten feet away; Transfer chain runs from the SD card through Audacity and Reaper, ending in xAct [3]
- **billystrings2019-11-01**: taped by Brain; transferred by Brain; source: AKG C568EB's & AKG 414 XLII's (wide cardiod)> Sound Devices MixPre-6 [4]
